checkpoints.note: First project-code consumption of the attacker-controlled unpack template. `String#unpack` binds the Ruby template argument into `tmpl->str`, which `read_tmpl()` then parses into the directive and oversized decimal count that drive the crash.

Root cause fixed by the patch. `read_tmpl()` rejects only parse failure, not the case where parsed `mrb_int n` is larger than `INT_MAX`, so the following `count = (int)n;` narrows an out-of-range attacker-controlled size into `int`.
